description: The State Statistical Office of North Macedonia publishes 2021 Census results in its MakStat PxWeb database, which has an open JSON API. The households and dwellings folder holds tables by municipality. Table T3003P21 counts dwellings by kitchen, bath and toilet, piped water source, sewage disposal from public or private plants or open ditches, electricity installation, central heating from a community heating centre or own installation, air conditioning and solar collectors, including collectors installed but not used. Table T2006P21 counts households by heating type and fuel, such as own central heating or stoves using electricity, firewood, coal, pellets, oil or gas, split by urban and rural settlement. Other tables give households by water supply, buildings with energy-efficient facades, lifts and disabled access, and dwellings by floor area and rooms, and one gives population, households and dwellings by settlement. Coverage is national. Format and access: free tables in the portal and as PX or JSON through the API, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: some variable names in the API are in Macedonian. Simulation uses: heating fuel mix and district heating connections by municipality for winter energy demand and air quality planning. Related records: IPUMS International and the Copernicus GHSL built-up grid.

schema_summary: T3003P21: dwellings by kitchen, bathing, toilet, piped water (community scheme, private, outside building, none), sewage (public plant, private plant, open ditch or cesspool, none), electricity installation, central heating (community heating centre, own installation, none), air conditioning, solar collectors (used, not used, none), by municipality. T2006P21: households by heating (central, own central heating by fuel, stove heating by fuel, air conditioner, none) and urban or rural. T2005P21: households by water supply system. T3005P21: buildings with energy-efficient facade, lift and disabled access. T3002P21 and T3004P21: dwellings by occupancy, floor area, rooms.
